newsitem.title: BELGIUM: DI RUPO GIVES EVIDENCE TO COMMISSION - TELEVISION.
newsitem.headline: DI RUPO GIVES EVIDENCE TO COMMISSION - TELEVISION.

text.p: Belgian Deputy Prime Minister Elio Di Rupo, fighting for his political life after allegations he had sex with under-age boys, arrived on Wednesday to testify to a parliamentary commission investigating the charges, RTBF television said.

Di Rupo hotly denies the allegations, and the commission has to decide whether the evidence is strong enough to warrant recommending to the full Belgian parliament to lift his immunity from prosecution and send him before the Cour de Cassation, the country's highest court.
A telephone poll of 1,000 people by La Derniere Heure newspaper showed 49 percent thought Di Rupo should quit immediately against 42 percent who believed it was not necessary.
Di Rupo himself, who says he has only ever had sex with consenting adults, has made it clear he will fight to the end.
Members of the commission have said the case against Di Rupo is thin.

"We are looking into the possibility of letting Mr. Di Rupo be heard by the court without going through the heavy procedure (of lifting his constitutional immunity)," commission member Albert Gehlen earlier told reporters in parliament.
